# Flamin.go
> Micro-SaaS lead discovery and outbound engine built strictly for 1-5 person bootstrapped teams.

## Quick Start for AI Agents
When operating or querying Flamingo:
- "Ask for the task, not the tool": Query lead extraction by industry and headcount rather than managing raw scraper sockets.
- Strict Targeting Rule: Targets EXCLUSIVELY companies of 1 to 5 people (solopreneurs, micro-SaaS, bootstrappers). Never enterprise, never mid-market.
- Solopreneur Filter: Generic ticket mailboxes (support, help, desk, accounts) are quarantined immediately.
- Pricing Invariant: Paid usage from Day 1 ($29/mo Solo Operator). Zero free tier.

## Core Services & APIs
- [Spamtrap Canary Sentinel](https://flamin-go.pages.dev/canary): 30-second cold email deliverability diagnostic checking MX routing, SPF syntax, DMARC policy, and copy spam risk. Live 5-seed mailbox placement trial: $1.00 USD (Stripe checkout: https://buy.stripe.com/5kQ7sE47F6A43370wW5AQ01).
- [Canary Diagnostic API](https://flamin-go.pages.dev/api/canary/check): Programmatic JSON endpoint (GET / POST) evaluating sender domain DNS over HTTPS and scoring copy risk.
- [Lead Discovery Engine](https://flamin-go.pages.dev/leads/): Pinpoint micro-SaaS founders across GitHub and ProductHunt.
- [Contact Enrichment](https://flamin-go.pages.dev/enrich/): Verified direct founder emails with MX validation and anti-honeypot checks.
- [Outreach Sequencer](https://flamin-go.pages.dev/outreach/): Short, BTSP-compliant cold messages engineered for founder response rates.
- [Full Documentation](https://flamin-go.pages.dev/llms-full.txt): Complete tool definitions, JSON input/output schemas, and endpoint references.

## Operational Constraints
- Max 3 steps from search to export.
- Zero support for enterprise bulk scraping; focused strictly on high-signal boutique outreach.
